newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore stocks down at noon, interest wanes.
newsitem.headline: Singapore stocks down at noon, interest wanes.

text.p: Singapore shares mostly drifted lower in in thin dealings on Monday with sentiment dampened by a sharp fall in Malaysian stocks traded over-the-counter.

"I think the market is going through a period of consolidation. The corporate results are expected to be flat so unless there are surprises on the upside, the market is not going to move," said a dealer with a Singapore brokerage.

Dealers said sentiment was also weighed down by weak Malaysian issues traded on the OTC market following the introduction of forex curbs in Malaysia. The UOB-OTC index plunged 16.94 points to 1,067.82 at noon.
Electronic issues came under some profit taking after recent sharp gains. Contract manufacturer Venture was down 30 cents to S$6.35 in active trading.
"The stock is very volatile because it ran up so much recently but interest is still very strong," a dealer said.
